personality_one_liner: A cheerful, vibrant, and highly tactile casual game interface that feels responsive, plush, and inherently playful.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Buttons and cards need breathing room to feel touchable and 'chunky'.

do's: Use solid chunky backgrounds with borders for a game-like UI.
Use subtle color overlays instead of blur for performance on low-end Android.
dont's: Do not use blur for gaming apps optimized for low-end devices.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: The main game lobby featuring the mascot, stats, and a big playful 'PLAY' button.

states.error: Card with sad mascot and retry button.

screens.layout: Top bar with Lives, Coins, and XP (pill-shaped containers). Center area dominated by the 'mascot_hero' image floating (using reanimated). Bottom area contains a massive, chunky pill-shaped 'JUGAR' CTA in brandPrimary, with secondary smaller buttons for Collection and Settings. Background can use the 'abstract_spheres' image with a top-to-bottom surface-colored gradient scrim to ensure UI readability.

screens.name: World Map
screens.layout: Vertical scroll or grid of 5 chunky cards (Burbujas y Pop, Colores y Formas, Arena y Texturas, Movimiento y Equilibrio, Minipuzles Relajantes). Each card uses surfaceSecondary, has a thick shadow or borderStrong simulating 3D volume, and an icon or image slice.

screens.name: Minigame
screens.layout: Full screen 'candy_background' with 80% opacity overlay to make the game board pop. Top HUD: Pause, Restart, Exit buttons using circular icon buttons. Score and timer centrally located.

screens.name: Results
screens.layout: Centered celebratory card on surfaceInverse (modal style). 1 to 3 huge stars (in brandTertiary), XP gained, Coins awarded. Big 'Next' button.

screens.name: No Lives Modal
screens.purpose: Monetization point when out of lives.
screens.layout: Full screen overlay. Sad mascot image. Countdown timer for next life. Big prominent button 'Ver Anuncio' (brand) and 'Comprar Premium' (brandSecondary).

screens.name: Collection
screens.layout: Grid of rounded square cards. Unlocked items are vibrant; locked items are muted or greyed out.

mascot_hero.alt: Cute 3D mascot character wearing a hat

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'Tactile / Playful' personality heavily. Avoid flat minimalist designs; make buttons look chunky and clickable using 'shadow_tier 2' or bottom borders to simulate 3D volume.
Since it's optimized for low-end Android, DO NOT use blur. Fall back to solid backgrounds or color overlays when elevation is needed.
The primary button 'JUGAR' on the home screen should be massive and positioned in the lower thumb zone.
Do NOT use dark mode. Stick strictly to the light theme provided.
Use Phosphor icons with filled variants for a bold, game-like look.
Make sure the UI doesn't look like an admin dashboard. Use bouncy animations (react-native-reanimated) for the mascot on the home screen, and overshoot springs for button presses.
